title: Professional Law School & Specialised Institutes
description: The sequential roadmap for LL.B graduates and specialised career aspirants to apply to the Ghana School of Law (GSL), Regional Maritime University (RMU), media, film, and peacekeeping institutes.

steps.title: Apply for Professional Law Course at Ghana School of Law
steps.why: Administered by the General Legal Council (GLC), completing the Professional Law Course (Barrister-at-Law) is mandatory to be called to the Ghana Bar.
steps.do_this_when: Following award of an accredited qualifying Bachelor of Laws (LL.B) degree.

options.label: Ghana School of Law Professional Course Online Application
options.notes: Entrance exam registration and application for the professional law course.

steps.title: Apply to Specialised Professional Academies & Institutes
steps.why: Ghana houses premier sub-regional academies for maritime engineering, journalism, film production, and security studies.
steps.do_this_when: When seeking specialised statutory qualifications in navigation, media, or peacekeeping.

options.label: Regional Maritime University Admissions
options.notes: Marine engineering, nautical science, and maritime logistics degrees.

options.label: Ghana Institute of Journalism Admissions
options.notes: Media, journalism, and corporate communication programmes.

options.label: National Film and Television Institute Admissions
options.notes: Film directing, animation, and broadcast production programmes.

options.label: Kofi Annan International Peacekeeping Training Centre Courses
options.notes: Security sector, conflict management, and international peace operations courses.
